name: claude-worklog-mcp
description: MCP server + Claude Code plugin that keeps a human-readable log of Claude’s work and carries project context across sessions

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.ts src/hook.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --minify --outdir=dist --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
